messages:
anna_support: Customer (acme-uk) opened a high-priority ticket after SSO stopped working post-IdP cert rotation. They see a 401 on SAML callback. 

carlos_sso: Can you paste the decoded SAMLResponse (just the Assertion/Audience + Signature)?

anna_support: Pasting sanitized parts. request_id=R-9b2
```
Assertion->Audience: https://eu.app.redwood-inference.com/tenant/acme-uk
Expected SP EntityID: https://app.redwood-inference.com/tenant/acme-uk
Signature KeyName: key-202402-old
```

devon_sre: Hmm, audience is the regional host (eu.app...) while our SP metadata lists the non-regional host (app...). Could be CDN host rewrite or tenant-level override. Any proxy in front? @olga_platform

olga_platform: We're running the new edge rewrite rule for regional hostnames (landing -> eu.app.*) since last week. It rewrites Host header but preserves original request URL in a forwarded header. That can break SAML Audience if IdP was configured with the rewritten host.

anna_support: Customer says IdP rotation happened at ~09:02 UTC and failures started immediately. They also note the ACS in their IdP metadata includes :443 (https://eu.app.redwood-inference.com:443/saml/acs) while our SP metadata has no port.

carlos_sso: Two likely issues: (1) Audience/entityID mismatch due to host rewrite, (2) SignedAssertion still using old cert (key-202402-old) even after rotation -> signature validation fails. We should confirm which error is thrown in our SAML logs: AUDIENCE_MISMATCH vs SIGNATURE_INVALID.

idp_watcher_bot: Alert: idp-metadata-pull for acme-uk returned two KeyDescriptors (sig): key-202402-old (expires 2025-02-12) and key-202402-new (active). Metadata timestamp: 2024-04-06T09:01:12Z.

devon_sre: Anna, can you repro locally by fetching the customer's IdP metadata and then validating a captured SAMLResponse? Quick commands to run on triage host: 
```
curl -sS 'https://idp.acme-uk.example/metadata.xml' > /tmp/acme-metadata.xml
xmllint --xpath "string(//md:EntityDescriptor/@entityID)" /tmp/acme-metadata.xml -N md=http://www.okta.com /tmp/acme-metadata.xml
# inspect KeyDescriptors and AssertionConsumerService locations
xmlstarlet sel -t -m '//md:KeyDescriptor' -v '@use' -o ':' -v 'ds:KeyInfo/ds:X509Data/ds:X509Certificate' -n -N md=http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig# -N ds=http://www.w3.org/2000/09/xmldsig#
```

anna_support: Ran fetch, confirmed metadata has ACS entries for both with and without :443 and an EntityDescriptor entityID="https://eu.app.redwood-inference.com/tenant/acme-uk" (they updated IdP to regional entityID during rotation). Customer expects our SP to accept both variants.

carlos_sso: We intentionally canonicalize SP entityID in our validation to the configured tenant-level value (https://app.redwood-inference.com/tenant/acme-uk). That canonicalization step doesn't currently accept regional host aliases. Two quick fixes: (A) add alias to tenant's allowed-entityids in our tenant config, (B) instruct customer to update IdP to use the canonical SP entityID. Option A is faster for immediate remediation.

devon_sre: For the signature issue: check our saml-verify logs for the request_id. If the Assertion is still signed by key-202402-old but IdP metadata now lists new key first, we may be hitting a propagation/race where their IdP rotates cert but still signs with the previous key for an hour. Our verifier should accept both keys if present in metadata. Confirm logs: 
```
grep 'R-9b2' /var/log/redwood/saml-verify.log | tail -n 20
# look for errors: SIGNATURE_INVALID or AUDIENCE_MISMATCH
```

anna_support: Log shows: "R-9b2 - SIGNATURE_INVALID - signing key not found in metadata" followed by "AUDIENCE_MISMATCH - expected https://app.redwood-inference.com/tenant/acme-uk". So both triggered.

carlos_sso: Root cause: IdP rotated entityID and added variant ACS with :443; edge CDN host rewrite means some incoming SAMLResponses contain the eu.app host in the Audience. Remediation plan: 
- Short term (minutes): add https://eu.app.redwood-inference.com/tenant/acme-uk and the :443 ACS variant to tenant's allowed entityIDs/ACS whitelist so we accept them. I'll open a config change.
- Short term for signature: update verifier to accept both keys present in metadata; we already fetch metadata but there was a caching/parse bug that ignored secondary KeyDescriptor entries -> I'll patch and release a hotfix.
- Long term: OLGA to update edge rewrite to preserve original host in SAML flow or inject X-Forwarded-Host and we canonicalize audience based on tenant mapping.

olga_platform: Will schedule host-rewrite tweak and add an exception for SAML paths so Host header is left untouched for /saml/* flows. Rolling a small edge change now (canary -> all).

anna_support: Customer onboarded; applied temporary tenant alias and they confirm login succeeds again. Keeping ticket open until hotfix and edge rule are deployed. :thumbsup:

carlos_sso: I'll push the verifier patch to staging and request emergency deploy. Patch note: "accept multiple KeyDescriptor sig entries; ignore whitespace/port variations in ACS comparison".

devon_sre: After deploy, we'll monitor 5xx/401 SAML errors for acme-uk and search for residual audience mismatch occurrences. I'll set an alert for >3 failures/min over 10m.

anna_support: Thanks team. I'll update the customer with the mitigation steps and ETA for the platform patch + edge config change.
